```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(fixest)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(webshot2)
library(modelsummary)
library(kableExtra)
library(marginaleffects)
library(margins)
library(interactions)


final_data <- read.csv("ClimateConflict_BAdata_PaulinaWolf.csv")
```

##Prep##
```{r}
# Create a unique grid-cell ID from lon/lat
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(cell_id = paste0("cell_", lon, "_", lat))

# Code missing lagged deaths & season intensity as 0
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    ag_season_intensity = replace_na(ag_season_intensity, 0),
    lagged_deaths = replace_na(lagged_deaths, 0))
# Do it as there is large 0 mass for ag_season_intensity, that is not because of missings, but because there are agriculturally non-vialble areas like desert and jungle where season intensity is 0
# Lagged deaths are missing when there was no conflict in the previous month, so the 0 can be substituted
```


##Models without time lag##
```{r, temperature model}
# Model 1 on cell-month level
model_temp1 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly * ag_season_intensity + temp_anomaly * has_excluded_group + lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month, data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
# Model 2 on country-level
model_temp2 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly * nd_gain_score + lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | country + year, data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
```

```{r, precipitation model}
# Model 1 on cm-level
model_precip1 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ precip_anomaly * ag_season_intensity + precip_anomaly * has_excluded_group +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month, data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
# Model 2 on cy-level
model_precip2 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ precip_anomaly * nd_gain_score +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | country + year, data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
```

```{r, climate disaster model}
# Model 1 on cm-level
model_disaster1 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ disaster_occurred * ag_season_intensity + disaster_occurred * has_excluded_group +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month, data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
# Model 2 on cy-level
model_disaster2 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ disaster_occurred * nd_gain_score +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | country + year, data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
```

##Models with timelags##
```{r, prep for time lags}
# Create 3, 6 and 12 month time lags 
final_data1 <- final_data %>%
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  arrange(year, month) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_anomaly_lag3 = lag(temp_anomaly, 3),
    precip_anomaly_lag3 = lag(precip_anomaly, 3),
    disaster_occurred_lag3 = lag(disaster_occurred, 3)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

final_data1 <- final_data1 %>%
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  arrange(year, month) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_anomaly_lag6 = lag(temp_anomaly, 6),
    precip_anomaly_lag6 = lag(precip_anomaly, 6),
    disaster_occurred_lag6 = lag(disaster_occurred, 6)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

final_data1 <- final_data1 %>%
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  arrange(year, month) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_anomaly_lag12 = lag(temp_anomaly, 12),
    precip_anomaly_lag12 = lag(precip_anomaly, 12),
    disaster_occurred_lag12 = lag(disaster_occurred, 12)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r, temp lags}
# Model 1
model_temp1_lag3 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly_lag3 * ag_season_intensity + temp_anomaly_lag3 * has_excluded_group +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month, data = final_data1, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
model_temp1_lag6 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly_lag6 * ag_season_intensity + temp_anomaly_lag6 * has_excluded_group +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month, data = final_data1, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
model_temp1_lag12 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly_lag12 * ag_season_intensity + temp_anomaly_lag12 * has_excluded_group +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year +  month, data = final_data1, cluster = ~cell_id
  )

# Model 2
model_temp2_lag3 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly_lag3 * nd_gain_score +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | country + year, data = final_data1, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
model_temp2_lag6 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly_lag6 * nd_gain_score +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | country + year, data = final_data1, cluster = ~cell_id
  )
model_temp2_lag12 <- feols(
  conflict_any ~ temp_anomaly_lag12 * nd_gain_score +lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | country + year, data = final_data1, cluster = ~cell_id
  )

# Visualization (not included in BA)
modelsummary(list("Temp (No Lag)" = model_temp1, 
                  "Temp (Lag 3M)" = model_temp1_lag3,
                  "Temp (Lag 6M)" = model_temp1_lag6,
                  "Temp (Lag 12M)" = model_temp1_lag12),
             output = "BATable1.png",                
             stars = TRUE,                   
             fmt = 5,                        
             statistic = "p.value",
             gof_omit = "IC|Log|Adj|RMSE|FE|Std.Errors"
)

modelsummary(list("Temp (No Lag)" = model_temp2, 
                  "Temp (Lag 3M)" = model_temp2_lag3,
                  "Temp (Lag 6M)" = model_temp2_lag6,
                  "Temp (Lag 12M)" = model_temp2_lag12),
             output = "BATable1.2.png",                
             stars = TRUE,                   
             fmt = 5,                        
             statistic = "p.value",
             gof_omit = "IC|Log|Adj|RMSE|FE|Std.Errors"
)
```

```{r, precipitation interaction visualization}
# Model without interaction
modelprecip_no_interaction <- feols(conflict_any ~ precip_anomaly + ag_season_intensity + lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month,
                              data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id)

# Model with interaction
modelprecip_with_interaction <- feols(conflict_any ~ precip_anomaly * ag_season_intensity + lagged_deaths + nightlight_z | cell_id + year + month,
                                data = final_data, cluster = ~cell_id)

# Predictions from model without interaction
pred_no_int <- plot_predictions(modelprecip_no_interaction, 
                                condition = "precip_anomaly", 
                                draw = FALSE)  

# With interaction: set ag_season_intensity to fixed levels (min & max)
pred_with_int_max <- plot_predictions(modelprecip_with_interaction,
                                  condition = list(
                                    precip_anomaly = seq(min(final_data$precip_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),         max(final_data$precip_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                         length.out = 100),
                                    ag_season_intensity =  12
                                  ),
                                  draw = FALSE)

pred_with_int_min <- plot_predictions(modelprecip_with_interaction,
                                  condition = list(
                                    precip_anomaly = seq(min(final_data$precip_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),         max(final_data$precip_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                         length.out = 100),
                                    ag_season_intensity =  -1
                                  ),
                                  draw = FALSE)


# Add a model label to distinguish
pred_no_int$model <- "Without agricultural season intensity"
pred_with_int_max$model <- "With high agricultural season intensity"
pred_with_int_min$model <- "With low agricultural season intensity"

# Combine datasets
all_preds <- rbind(pred_no_int, pred_with_int_max, pred_with_int_min)

# Plot
precipplot <- ggplot(all_preds, aes(x = precip_anomaly, y = estimate, color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = model), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
 labs(
    x = "Abnormal Precipitation",
    y = "Predicted Probability of Conflict",
    color = "Model Type",
    fill = "Model Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save
ggsave("precipxagintenstiy.png",plot = precipplot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

  "disaster_occurred_lag12:ag_season_intensity" = "Ag. Intensity × Disaster",


  "temp_anomaly:has_excluded_groupTRUE" = "Ethnic Exclusion × Temperature",

  "precip_anomaly_lag12:has_excluded_groupTRUE" = "Ethnic Exclusion × Precipitation",

  "disaster_occurred:has_excluded_groupTRUE" = "Ethnic Exclusion × Disaster",
  "disaster_occurred_lag3:has_excluded_groupTRUE" = "Ethnic Exclusion × Disaster",
  "disaster_occurred_lag6:has_excluded_groupTRUE" = "Ethnic Exclusion × Disaster",
  "disaster_occurred_lag12:has_excluded_groupTRUE" = "Ethnic Exclusion × Disaster"
)

# List models
models1_table <- list(
  "Temp (No Lag)" = model_temp1,
  "Temp (3M Lag)" = model_temp1_lag3,
  "Temp (6M Lag)" = model_temp1_lag6,
  "Temp (12M Lag)" = model_temp1_lag12,
  "Precip (No Lag)" = model_precip1,
  "Precip (3M Lag)" = model_precip1_lag3,

  "Precip (12M Lag)" = model_precip1_lag12,
  "Disaster (No Lag)" = model_disaster1,

  "Disaster (6M Lag)" = model_disaster1_lag6,
  "Disaster (12M Lag)" = model_disaster1_lag12

# Generate table
modelsummary(
